fields.name: after_id
fields.short: The ID of the Epic we want to move this Epic after.

fields.name: app_url
fields.short: The Shortcut application url for the Epic.

fields.name: archived
fields.short: True/false boolean that indicates whether the Epic is archived or not.

fields.name: associated_groups
fields.short: An array containing Group IDs and Group-owned story counts for the Epic's associated groups.

fields.name: before_id
fields.short: The ID of the Epic we want to move this Epic before.

fields.name: comments
fields.short: A nested array of threaded comments.

fields.name: completed
fields.short: A true/false boolean indicating if the Epic has been completed.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.short: The time/date the Epic was completed.

fields.name: completed_at_override
fields.short: A manual override for the time/date the Epic was completed.

fields.name: converted_from_story_id
fields.short: The ID of the Story that was converted to an Epic.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The time/date the Epic was created.

fields.name: deadline
fields.short: The Epic's deadline.

fields.name: description
fields.short: The Epic's description.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.short: A string description of this resource.

fields.name: epic_state_id
fields.short: The ID of the Epic State.

fields.name: external_id
fields.short: This field can be set to another unique ID.

fields.name: follower_ids
fields.short: An array of UUIDs for any Members you want to add as Followers on this Epic.

fields.name: group_id
fields.short: `Deprecated` The ID of the group to associate with the epic.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.short: An array of UUIDS for Groups to which this Epic is related.

fields.name: group_mention_ids
fields.short: An array of Group IDs that have been mentioned in the Epic description.

fields.name: health
fields.short: The current health status of the Epic.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique ID of the Epic.

fields.name: label_ids
fields.short: An array of Label ids attached to the Epic.

fields.name: labels
fields.short: An array of Labels attached to the Epic.

fields.name: member_mention_ids
fields.short: An array of Member IDs that have been mentioned in the Epic description.

fields.name: mention_ids
fields.short: `Deprecated:` use `member_mention_ids`.

fields.name: milestone_id
fields.short: `Deprecated` The ID of the Objective this Epic is related to.

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the Epic.

fields.name: objective_ids
fields.short: An array of IDs for Objectives to which this epic is related.

fields.name: owner_ids
fields.short: An array of UUIDs for any members you want to add as Owners on this new Epic.

fields.name: planned_start_date
fields.short: The Epic's planned start date.

fields.name: position
fields.short: The Epic's relative position in the Epic workflow state.

fields.name: productboard_id
fields.short: The ID of the associated productboard feature.

fields.name: productboard_name
fields.short: The name of the associated productboard feature.

fields.name: productboard_plugin_id
fields.short: The ID of the associated productboard integration.

fields.name: productboard_url
fields.short: The URL of the associated productboard feature.

fields.name: project_ids
fields.short: The IDs of Projects related to this Epic.

fields.name: requested_by_id
fields.short: The ID of the Member that requested the epic.

fields.name: started
fields.short: A true/false boolean indicating if the Epic has been started.

fields.name: started_at
fields.short: The time/date the Epic was started.

fields.name: started_at_override
fields.short: A manual override for the time/date the Epic was started.

fields.name: state
fields.short: `Deprecated` The workflow state that the Epic is in.

fields.name: stats
fields.short: A group of calculated values for this Epic.

fields.name: stories_without_projects
fields.short: The number of stories in this epic which are not associated with a project.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.short: The time/date the Epic was updated.

fields.name: app_url
fields.short: The Shortcut application url for the Comment.

fields.name: author_id
fields.short: The unique ID of the Member who is the Comment's author.

fields.name: blocker
fields.short: Marks the comment as a blocker that can be surfaced to permissions or teams mentioned in the comment.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The time/date when the Comment was created.

fields.name: deleted
fields.short: True/false boolean indicating whether the Comment has been deleted.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.short: A string description of this resource.

fields.name: external_id
fields.short: This field can be set to another unique ID.

fields.name: group_mention_ids
fields.short: The unique IDs of the Group who are mentioned in the Comment.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique ID of the Comment.

fields.name: linked_to_slack
fields.short: Whether the Comment is currently the root of a thread that is linked to Slack.

fields.name: member_mention_ids
fields.short: The unique IDs of the Member who are mentioned in the Comment.

fields.name: mention_ids
fields.short: `Deprecated:` use `member_mention_ids`.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.short: The ID of the parent Comment this Comment is threaded under.

fields.name: position
fields.short: The Comments numerical position in the list from oldest to newest.

fields.name: reactions
fields.short: A set of Reactions to this Comment.

fields.name: story_id
fields.short: The ID of the Story on which the Comment appears.

fields.name: text
fields.short: The text of the Comment.

fields.name: unblocks_parent
fields.short: Marks the comment as an unblocker to its blocker parent.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.short: The time/date when the Comment was updated.
